description_en: Queries the recording plan of a video device based on the device ID of an IPC
description_zh: 调用该接口根据IPC的设备ID，查询该视频设备的录像计划
name: QueryRecordPlanDeviceByDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value exists for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query this ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId serves as the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0: main stream
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：
0：主码流
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码

Name.description_en: The name of the recording plan template

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the time template associated with the recording plan
TemplateId.description_zh: 录像计划关联的时间模板ID

AllDay.description_en:
Indicates whether recording is enabled 24/7. Valid values:

1: Yes.
0: No. For detailed configuration, see the TimeSectionList parameter
AllDay.description_zh:
是否7天*24小时录像：

1：是。
0：否，详细配置请查看TimeSectionList参数

Default.description_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:
1: default template
0: custom template
Default.description_zh:
模板类型：
1：默认模板
0：自定义模板

Name.description_en: The name of the time template

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the time template

Begin.description_en: The start time of each day. Valid values: 0 to 86399. Unit: seconds
Begin.description_zh: 每天开始的时间，取值范围0~86399，单位为秒

DayOfWeek.description_en: The day of the week. Valid values: 0 to 6, representing Sunday through Saturday
DayOfWeek.description_zh: 每周的周几，取值范围0~6，表示周日~周六

End.description_en: The end time of each day. Valid values: 1 to 86399. Unit: seconds
End.description_zh: 每天结束的时间，取值范围1~86399，单位为秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
